summary: Completed public API and responsive browser regression testing for NA Engineering Solutions.
action_items: Consider adding server-side MIME/type validation for attachments; the API currently enforces size but accepts arbitrary file content despite the UI allow-list.
critical_code_review_comments: Quote attachment validation checks size but not extension or MIME type; this is a security/requirements hardening gap.
seed_data_creation: Created two TEST quote records through public quote tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All requested routes, seven service listing/detail navigation, mobile menu, quote submission, attachment acceptance, and mobile overflow passed against the public URL. First browser script had a harness assertion issue; a direct-route rerun passed.
rca of the issue: No runtime defects reproduced. The only review finding is defense-in-depth: backend accepts arbitrary attachment MIME/content because it only checks UploadFile.size; UI accept filtering is client-side and bypassable.
